turns.content: In the estimate alpha^3 g^2 sqrt(2) 8 (4pi)^-6 (Q/M)^2, identify the factor that conventionally carries loop suppression in four-dimensional QFT.
State the standard four-dimensional loop-measure power-counting rule that relates one loop to powers of 4pi.
Write the one-loop suppression both as (16pi^2)^-1 and as a power of 4pi.
Match the displayed exponent -6 to L copies of the one-loop factor and write the equation for L.
Assess the inference's dependence on the assumption that all displayed 4pi powers arise from loop measures rather than a different normalization convention.
State the loop count as the intended standard naive-dimensional-analysis estimate with calibrated confidence.
Verify the result by rewriting (4pi)^-6 as a power of 16pi^2, and state the normalization assumption used.
Give the final loop count and its convention qualification.
